# title: I Remember Clifford: A Tribute to Clifford Brown
description: Dimitris Papadopoulos (trumpet), Dimitris Bakopoulos (guitar), Konstantinos Stouraitis (bass) and Dimitris Koutantos (drums) play the music of Clifford Brown, the trumpeter who defined hard bop before dying at 25. The 12€ contribution supports the venue's community kitchen and includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.

Giorgos Koutsikoulis (guitar), Stergios Polyzos (tenor saxophone), Antonis Arvanitis (double bass) and Dimitris Koutantos (drums) perform live the music of their album Resonance, out on Jazz Breeze Records: seven originals in a bebop and hard-bop idiom, with the emphasis on groove and interplay. The 12€ contribution includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.

Stergios Polyzos (tenor saxophone), Lambros Psomas (double bass) and Christos Koutsoukos (drums) play standards and improvisations without a chordal instrument, in the pianoless tradition of Sonny Rollins. The 12€ contribution includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.

Pianist Aris Papadopoulos meets guitarist George Stavroulakis's augmented guitar, an instrument that pairs electric-guitar phrasing with synthesizer textures: originals and freely reworked jazz standards between jazz, creative music and free improvisation. The 12€ contribution includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.

Nassia Gofa and the Jazz Tales feat. Jykä Ahola
description: Vocalist Nassia Gofa with Stefanos Kozanis (piano) and Kostas Patsiotis (double bass), the core of Nassia Gofa & The Jazz Tales, join Finnish trumpeter Jykä Ahola for a tribute to Helen Merrill: jazz standards the great singer stamped with her historic recordings. The 12€ contribution includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.

Konstantinos Mitropoulos (guitar) and Nikos Sidirokastritis (drums) play and improvise on music from their album Instinct, with guitarist Costas Baltazanis as guest. The 12€ contribution includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.

Ariadne Meyer (voice), Nontas Lambrineas (piano), Konstantinos Mentzelopoulos (double bass) and Evangelia Stavrou (drums) play well-loved jazz and Latin jazz melodies; first appearance of the band at the venue. The 12€ contribution includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.

Chrysostomos Boukalis (double bass), Kostas Yaxoglou (piano) and Nikos Sidirokastritis (drums) open with the repertoire of Charlie Haden and move on to originals and creative arrangements, a journey across countries and idioms. The 12€ contribution includes a beer, wine or soft drink; self-service bar.
